scenarios.title: Complete lesson: checked JSON directly
given: Course DEMO 101, Invented Route Workshop; scope labels, tags and route order; term unknown. No formal objectives were supplied.
Readable passage A: A route is an ordered list of stops. A label names one stop. Changing a label does not change route order. Rearranging stops changes the order.
Readable passage B: A tag groups stops by a shared feature. Two stops may share a tag while retaining different labels.
These are the entire selected passages for this small invented lesson; their availability does not establish coverage of any larger course.
scenarios.expectedFirstReply: You want to understand labels, tags and route order in DEMO 101. I can read both pasted passages. I’ll explain how the ideas differ, connect them with examples and give you useful practice.
expectedNext: Explain labels, tags and route order with concrete practice and supported derived objectives. Keep term null and do not pad this small source with invented depth.
Review source support, coverage, answers and JSON internally; deliver the actual titled file without a draft-first exchange.
scenarios.expectedAfterReply: Deliver the complete checked notebook file and a brief note about its actual content and any gaps.
scenarios.necessaryPause: None once complete inputs are available.
mustPreserve: All facts and qualifications from both supplied passages.
Explicit source versus generated-objective/practice status.
Deliver checked final JSON and required actual images in one titled ZIP directly unless a draft-only stage or pause was explicitly requested.
scenarios.companionReviewMessage:
- Labels name individual stops; tags group stops by a shared feature.
- Route order changes when stops move; renaming a stop alone leaves the order unchanged.
- Practice asks you to distinguish naming a stop, grouping stops and changing their order.

The checked notebook file is attached; important source limits remain in the content.

mustPreserve: Newest saved student edits, stable identities and exact evidence.
